description: N12's full-length calibration run, the preregistration's check before the real run: seed 3001, all four arms (clean, n80, n80-mix, sub20) and both frozen fits, on the full training schedule, measured on the held-out tail's windows 513-1024. NEEDS AN A100: before Run all, choose Runtime > Change runtime type > A100 GPU. On any other GPU it stops before training. About 15-20 minutes. Resumable: if a session ends, choose Run all again and finished work is skipped.
